1924.statement: When a MAN asks marriage, Lilly names the Sun together with Moon as additional significators under his historical gender-specific scheme.
1924.limit: Do not characterize these as proven innate or natural human roles; the source uses a historical conventional pairing.

1928.limit: Opening paragraph begins original PDF336 and continues onto PDF337; include both original pages in locator.

2005.statement: If either partner's significators are vitiated or joined to Saturn or Mars WHEN THOSE PLANETS ARE NOT significators in the question, or are with the printed South Node ☋, Lilly calls the marriage illegitimate.
2005.precondition: Saturn/Mars status as NON-significator, or distinct South-Node condition, is essential.
2005.limit: 'Unlawful marriage' is Lilly's historic label, not a modern legal determination; South Node glyph is legible in print.

2006.statement: First and seventh lords in trine or sextile are offered as testimony of agreement AFTER marriage; separately Moon beholding its own dispositor OR lord of exaltation by good aspect is given the same inference.
2006.precondition: These are separate alternative agreement testimonies, not Moon testimony only strengthening the first.
2006.limit: Do not omit lunar exaltation-lord alternative or make house placement compulsory.

2007.statement: When NEITHER first nor seventh lord is angular, Lilly judges which spouse is more weighty/strong and would be master or strive for mastery; afflicted Sun is worst for man, afflicted Venus worst for woman, afflicted Moon bad for both.
2007.precondition: No angular placement of either principal lord for fallback comparison; planetary affliction clauses are sex-specific.
2007.limit: Source uses 'or strive for it' and 'impedited' distinctions, not guaranteed dominance.

2009.statement: Original print across PDF343–344 includes first and seventh lords in square/opposition or an impeded Moon's lord beholding ascendant; Mars or a retrograde/combust planet in ascendant implies quarrels due to QUERENT; similar affliction to seventh lord attributed to desired party.
2009.precondition: Read earlier house-lord hard aspects and parallel first/seventh afflictions; source continues across page break.
2009.limit: No real person's moral responsibility is established from this 1647 system.

2010.statement: For a question asked by a MAN, Saturn, Mars or SOUTH NODE ☋ in ascendant supplies an additional historical argument of contention attributed to the querent or woman, following the Moon affliction clause.
2010.precondition: The specific ascendant placement and male-querent condition are source-essential.
2010.limit: Earlier draft omitted this explicit Saturn/Mars/☋ placement; do not apply as universal.

2011.statement: If the THIRD-HOUSE LORD is the planet afflicting or hindering and is IN ASCENDANT OR SEVENTH HOUSE, Lilly attributes the contention to brethren or kindred.
2011.precondition: Third lord both afflicts and occupies either of the named houses.
2011.limit: The house condition cannot be omitted or treated as a proven real-world culprit.

2017.statement: Moon aspecting OR conjunct Saturn or Mars in the specified conflict context is said to threaten quick death or misfortune; only when that CONJUNCTION is in tenth or fourth does Lilly add the masculine/feminine-sign assignment to which partner suffers.
2017.precondition: Moon aspects OR conjoins Saturn/Mars; 10th/4th conditional restricts the partner/gender attribution.
2017.limit: The source speculates about death and conflict; neither has independent verified outcomes.

2019.statement: An afflicted Moon, eighth/twelfth placement, or void of course is said to bring troubles, grief or sickness; if related afflicted planets are angular Lilly describes a PROBABILITY of separation OR long disagreements.
2019.precondition: Match each affliction and house case to its own branch rather than pooling simultaneous conditions.
2019.limit: The author says probability, not certain separation; the alternative prolonged conflict remains explicit.

2020.statement: The unnumbered heading reads 'THAT the Marriage shall be broken, and the cause thereof', not a question asking WHEN.
2020.limit: Heading spans source divider/passage; do not invent a timing test.

2021.statement: Although at present a marriage may appear VERY FEASIBLE, a heavily afflicted planet receiving the significators' light (square/opposition with ill planet, cadent etc.) is offered as cause of its later break-off.
2021.precondition: Initially feasible match, relevant light-receiver with specified adverse aspect or place.
2021.limit: Do not omit the initial feasibility contrast; source is author conjecture.

2026.statement: If an ill planet carries/translates light between the signifiers and disrupts their union, the author instructs astrologer to DESCRIBE THAT PLANET to the party to warn about alleged mediator.
2026.precondition: Actual evil planet transporting light and causing break-off.
2026.limit: Printed source says describe planet; does not command identifying the actual person by house alone.

2027.statement: The Arabic aphorism concerns the Moon between the SEVENTEENTH DEGREE OF SAGITTARIUS and the FIRST MINUTE OF CAPRICORN: a woman who DEPARTS FROM HER HUSBAND or becomes widow is said never to return or remarry.
2027.precondition: Exact 17° Sagittarius to early Capricorn lunar range, plus separated-wife OR widow circumstance.
2027.limit: The printed margin warns not to credit Arabic aphorisms without other significators; no real return or remarriage verified.

2031.statement: For a spouse alleged likely to die first, first-house lord retrograde/combust/in fall or NEAR LORD OF THE EIGHTH is applied to the man; like seventh lord to woman; afflicted SUN is worst for man, afflicted VENUS for woman.
2031.precondition: The near condition concerns lord of eighth, not merely the eighth house; map Sun and Venus gender directions.
2031.limit: No patient mortality validation; the printed Venus glyph is slightly worn.

2032.statement: Lilly writes 'Usually I observe': the relevant significator first combust in TROPICK (cardinal) signs Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn is assigned a shorter time; common/mutable signs longer; fixed longest until alleged death.
2032.precondition: First combust significator and its sign modality; terms are historical Tropick versus common versus fixed.
2032.limit: This is a qualitative timeline with no calibrated elapsed years or observed lifespans.

2033.statement: Unnumbered heading 'Which of the two shall live longest' starts at foot of printed311/PDF345 and continues into PDF346.
2033.limit: Exact cross-page source boundary; do not start it only on PDF346.

2034.statement: In comparing the first and seventh lords to infer longer life, Lilly considers who is better placed, more essentially dignified, in good aspect to fortunate planets, and MORE REMOTE from the presence or evil aspect of the relevant EIGHTH-HOUSE LORD.
2034.precondition: Comparison of BOTH first/seventh signifiers and afflictions, including better fortune aspects and remoteness from eighth ruler.
2034.limit: Comparative source prediction about mortality, not independent verification.
